summary: A bounded primary-source review: LOC-1 is a verified preregistered proposal with no reported measurements. Existing simulations, acoustic force models, clinical questions and quantum channels require distinct observables and evidence.

sources.title: Shukla et al. — Effectiveness of Binaural Beats in Reducing Dental Pain and Anxiety among Children and Adults: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis (2025)

comparisons.title: Location comparison: proposal versus existing numerical lab
comparisons.currentImplementation: Location Spectrum Lab simulates selected hollow/solid elastic modes, passive fixture coupling, projection and temperature confounds. Defaults include44.45 mm radius and illustrative0.5 mm shell; no physical measurements.
comparisons.sphereProposal: Track an identified >230 kHz hollow-sphere mode against a stationary reference under the registered randomized A/B protocol.
comparisons.evidenceBoundary: The existing ~23 kHz illustrative shell mode is not the proposed >230 kHz target; geometry, mode family and estimator must be chosen explicitly. Registration is a study plan.
comparisons.nextTest: Compare like-for-like mode definitions and covariance-aware synthetic trial blocks; preserve source protocol versus exploratory controls as separate configurations.

comparisons.title: Acoustic trapping is a force-balance problem
comparisons.currentImplementation: A separate bounded Rayleigh/Gor’kov model is under panel review.
comparisons.sphereProposal: LOC-1 does not claim acoustic levitation or weight cancellation.
comparisons.evidenceBoundary: Radiation-force trapping uses external acoustic power, finite particle contrast and stable equilibria; it does not establish intrinsic location encoding.
comparisons.nextTest: Require force versus gravity, curvature/stability, radius-to-wavelength validity and drive-off controls.

comparisons.title: Beat arithmetic and clinical claims are separate
comparisons.currentImplementation: Two-tone audio can model carrier frequencies, spectral lines and an envelope.
comparisons.sphereProposal: Sphere project explicitly excludes medical benefit.
comparisons.evidenceBoundary: A 2023 review finds inconsistent EEG entrainment; a 2025 dental review reports some favorable anxiety outcomes but low-certainty evidence, high bias and inconclusive pain versus no intervention. Neither proves universal healing or a unique curative frequency. Monaural beat arithmetic is not dichotic binaural stimulation.
comparisons.nextTest: Keep acoustic beat predictions deterministic; assess health claims only through outcome-specific controlled clinical evidence, supplied separately.

comparisons.title: Resonance amplification requires an energy budget
comparisons.currentImplementation: Existing coupled-coil and passive fixture models declare sources, storage and losses.
comparisons.sphereProposal: RF instrumentation can characterize a channel; it does not turn optical/mechanical and EM spectra into the same observable.
comparisons.evidenceBoundary: Large amplitude or voltage at resonance does not by itself show power gain or energy creation.
comparisons.nextTest: Check zero drive, stronger loss, timestep convergence and independently integrated work/energy balance.

comparisons.title: Quantum information transfer has a different object and protocol
comparisons.currentImplementation: A separate exact qubit-channel model is under panel review.
comparisons.evidenceBoundary: Quantum state transfer uses entanglement and classical communication. The selected 2024 fiber preprint is a probabilistic optical experiment; an ideal four-outcome qubit simulation does not reproduce its hardware and does not transport copper matter.
comparisons.nextTest: Compare conditional versus feed-forward-corrected output and resource/classical-channel requirements.

comparisons.title: Historical and occult patterns can motivate testable maps
comparisons.currentImplementation: The integrated archive preserves historical claims, selected symbolic patterns and explicit image-to-sound mappings.
comparisons.sphereProposal: The project attributes motivation to Bashar material without treating it as established physical evidence.
comparisons.evidenceBoundary: A motif, sigil, statue or chosen pitch does not determine a unique physical resonance or prove hidden causal connection.
comparisons.nextTest: Freeze the mapping and channel, include alternative/null patterns and report sensitivity before interpreting meaning.
